StudyAgent Demo Notes

The Aurora study method has three steps: retrieve, explain, and verify.
First, retrieve one idea from memory without looking at the notes.
Second, explain the idea in plain language and connect it to an example.
Third, verify the explanation against the source and correct any gap.

A short session lasts 25 minutes: 15 minutes to retrieve and explain,
5 minutes to verify, and 5 minutes to write two flashcards.

The method recommends reviewing a difficult flashcard after one day,
three days, and seven days. Its purpose is to combine active recall,
explanation, source checking, and spaced review in one repeatable routine.
